bio_draft: Unnayanaa is the project of Bangalore DJ and producer Prashanth Pallemoni, whose music draws on Afrobeat, house, jazz and Brazilian rhythms. He has released on Rainy City Music, Borders Of Light, Wind Horse Records and his own label Alternate Art Forms, including tracks built from recordings made in Ethiopia and Congo. He has hosted the monthly show Syncopate on boxout.fm and debuted his Osmosis live show at Magnetic Fields in 2023.

bio_draft: VRIDIAN is an electronic music project from New Delhi led by Vir Rattan Chowdhry (Vir RC), who calls his music deep, emotive and groovy electronic music. He has released on Qilla Records and Manjumasi, moving from melodic techno and minimal house to darker techno on the 2025 EP 'Days Of Paradiso'.
notes: Wild City (2018) and Beatport describe Vridian as a duo of Vir Rattan Chowdhry and Siddhant (Sidhant) Jain; later Wild City pieces (2020 on) treat it as Vir RC alone, with Siddhant Jain credited separately as ELM on 'Megara'. Beatport bio mentions 2017 international releases on Kiko Records, Substation Recordings and RF Music (titles not confirmed). The Wild City #151 SoundCloud link is a private (s-) link, so the Mixcloud URL is given. A Spotify id appeared on a third-party site but could not be confirmed; spotify left null. Fred Perry profile has no date.
